data.long_meaning: The name Algernon is derived from the Old French name Alain, which means 'handsome' or 'notable'. In Latin, it is derived from the name Alanus, which means 'rock' or 'handsome'. In medieval Europe, Algernon was a popular name for noblemen and knights. The name Algernon carries the meaning “Noble or Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Algernon usually hope their child will grow to embody noble or handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
